pages.title: Cat Noir Posing with a Heart in a Santa Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Cat Noir poses with a heart between his gloved hands in this printable coloring page, wearing his eye mask beneath a fluffy Santa hat. Outlined hearts and circles surround his tousled hair and smiling face, while the hat pompom, wide cuffs, and large costume panels provide broad enclosed sections.

pages.title: Three Girls in Santa Hats Behind a Christmas Gift Coloring Page
pages.description: Three smiling girls peek over a Christmas gift in this printable coloring page, wearing fluffy Santa hats beneath large lettering that reads Merry Christmas. A large bow and ribbon divide the dotted gift box, with two pairs of hands resting along its top edge. Different hairstyles and broad hat panels contrast with the smaller bow folds and circular decorations.

pages.title: Pepe the Frog in a Santa Hat Wrapped in Lights Coloring Page
pages.description: Pepe the Frog wears a Santa hat in this printable coloring page, with a string of lights winding across its fluffy brim and long tip. His heavy eyelids and broad closed mouth fill the lower portrait. Large face and hat sections contrast with the narrow wire, small bulb bases, and scalloped fur edges.

pages.title: Pepe the Frog Holding Candy Canes in a Santa Suit Coloring Page
pages.description: Pepe the Frog holds a striped candy cane in this printable coloring page, wearing a fluffy Santa hat, matching coat, and a buckled belt. Another candy cane rises behind his shoulder, with circles and a sparkle filling the background. Broad cheeks, gloves, and costume panels contrast with the narrow candy stripes and textured trim.

pages.title: Santa Claus Portrait with a Fluffy Beard Coloring Page
pages.description: Santa Claus wears a pompom hat and coat in this printable coloring page, with wide round eyes, a thick mustache, and a rounded beard. His coat has a wide strip of fluffy trim down the front and a large belt buckle. Straight wall and door lines contrast with the rounded beard, hat pompom, and broad clothing sections.

pages.title: Stormtrooper Wearing a Santa Hat and Scarf Coloring Page
pages.description: A stormtrooper wears a Santa hat and scarf in this printable coloring page, with star shapes across the hat band above the familiar helmet. The helmet's eye panels, mouth vents, and round filters remain visible above a scarf patterned with a grid. Broad helmet plates contrast with small vent slots, star points, and the narrow scarf fringe.

pages.title: Santa Claus Blowing a Kiss in a Pompom Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Santa Claus blows a kiss in this printable coloring page, with a long beard, floppy hat, and one mitten held close to his mouth. A rounded puff shape floats beside his face, while simple folds mark the hat and sleeve. Large beard and costume sections contrast with the small finger outlines, curled pompom, and narrow brim.

pages.title: Peter Griffin in a Santa Suit Holding an Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: Peter Griffin holds a Christmas tree ornament in this printable coloring page, wearing a fluffy Santa suit, round glasses, and a hat with a pompom. One boot lifts as he leans sideways, with his other gloved hand open beside him. The tiny tree ornament, stars, and scattered circles add smaller sections around the broad coat, collar, and belt.

pages.title: Brian Griffin Carrying a Plate of Candy Canes Coloring Page
pages.description: Brian Griffin carries a plate of candy canes in this printable coloring page, wearing a festive sweater patterned with Christmas trees and zigzag borders. His free paw rests on his hip, with a doorway, a table, and leafy decorations behind him. Broad sweater and face sections contrast with the narrow candy stripes, ribbed cuffs, and small tree shapes.

pages.title: Homer Simpson Decorating a Tree with Donuts Coloring Page
pages.description: Homer Simpson decorates a Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, holding a donut ornament beside branches filled with sprinkled donuts, round baubles, and lights. A large star tops the tree, and gift boxes sit below it beside the floorboards. His collared shirt and broad arms contrast with the small sprinkles, pine needles, and garland on the mantel.

pages.title: Cat and Duck Beside a Decorated Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A cat peeks from a stocking while a duck stands beside a decorated Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, beneath scattered falling snow. The duck balances on a small wooden stool near strings of beads and patterned baubles. Stars, crescent moons, and cat-shaped ornaments cover the tree, with Merry Christmas lettering in the background.

pages.title: Cat Placing a Star on a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A cat reaches toward the star atop a Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, balancing on stacked presents covered in hearts and tiny trees. Round baubles, looping garlands, and small stars decorate the branches. The cat stretches one hind leg behind it, beneath the playful Meowy Christmas greeting.

pages.title: Bugs Bunny Waving from a Christmas Sleigh Coloring Page
pages.description: Bugs Bunny waves from a sleigh filled with wrapped gifts in this printable coloring page, wearing a Santa hat and a coat with fluffy trim. Large snowflakes surround his long ears beneath the Merry Christmas greeting. Ribbon bows and curling carved patterns decorate the presents and the sleigh's tall sides and runners.

pages.title: Grinch Grinning Beneath a Starry Santa Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: The Grinch grins beneath a star-patterned Santa hat in this printable coloring page, framed by oversized letters spelling his name and small diamond-shaped sparkles. His wide smile and narrowed eyes fill the central portrait. Fluffy trim surrounds his face and neck, while repeated Grinch lettering forms broad outlined shapes across the background.

pages.title: Pink Panther Decorating a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: The Pink Panther lifts a round ornament toward a Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, wearing a Santa hat and smiling at the branches. Strings of small lights curve between the larger baubles. A five-pointed star tops the tree, while his long arms, narrow body, and curling tail fill the other side of the scene.

pages.title: Tabby Kitten Wearing a Santa Hat and Scarf Coloring Page
pages.description: A tabby kitten sits in a Santa hat and fluffy scarf in this printable coloring page, looking forward with large round eyes and long whiskers. Irregular stripes mark its cheeks, forehead, legs, and curved tail. The soft hat brim and pompom contrast with the scarf's wide band and the kitten's small outlined paws.

pages.title: Merry Christmas Lettering with Festive Patterns Coloring Page
pages.description: Merry Christmas lettering fills this printable coloring page, with a Santa hat, bow, holly sprig, and reindeer antlers decorating the large outlined words. Checks, diagonal stripes, dots, and tiny trees create different patterns inside the letters. Snowflakes and small stars surround the greeting, while the flowing lower word adds large curved spaces.

pages.title: Cat Hugging a Snowman in Holiday Hats Coloring Page
pages.description: A cat hugs a smiling snowman in this printable coloring page, both wearing holiday hats decorated with leaves and berries above their closed eyes. Striped scarves wrap around their necks, and round buttons mark the snowman's body. The cat presses its cheek close while the snowman's mittened hands lift beside the cozy pose.

pages.title: Santa Claus Smiling Behind Three Wrapped Gifts Coloring Page
pages.description: Santa Claus smiles behind three wrapped gifts in this printable coloring page, wearing a drooping pompom hat, fluffy cuffs, and a belt with a square buckle. His curled mustache sits above a full flowing beard. Snowflakes and round snow dots fill the background, while ribbon bows and star patterns decorate the presents.

pages.title: Cinnamoroll Flying with a Christmas Gift Sack Coloring Page
pages.description: Cinnamoroll flies above a snowy village in this printable coloring page, carrying a gift sack with a wrapped present and a star-topped wand inside. His long ears stretch outward, and his curled tail loops behind the sack. Small stars, falling snow, fir trees, and snow-covered rooftops fill the scene around a winding path.

pages.title: Santa Upside Down in a Chimney with a Reindeer Coloring Page
pages.description: Santa falls headfirst into a snowy chimney in this printable coloring page, with his boots sticking up as a reindeer laughs beside the brickwork. Large Merry Christmas lettering fills the sky above the scene. Snow dots, the reindeer's scarf, and Santa's belt buckle add smaller details to the broad roof and lettering shapes.

pages.title: Grogu Holding a Snowball in a Santa Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Grogu holds a large snowball with both hands in this printable coloring page, wearing a floppy Santa hat over his wide ears and wrinkled brow. Smaller snowballs and scattered snow dots surround his long robe. The curved snowbanks leave broad spaces beside the finer lines of his fingers, eyes, and folded sleeves.

pages.title: Pepe the Frog Holding a Mug in a Santa Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Pepe the Frog holds a mug in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath a floppy Santa hat with large sparkling eyes and a patterned sweater. Zigzag bands and rows of dots run across the sweater below his wide mouth. The close portrait centers his face, hat, and cup against a plain background.

pages.title: Santa Dabbing While Wrapped in Christmas Lights Coloring Page
pages.description: Santa strikes a dab pose in this printable coloring page, wearing sunglasses as a string of Christmas lights wraps around his hat, arms, and coat. A star tops the pointed hat, and a broad belt crosses his waist. Individual bulbs and boot buckles add small details to the otherwise open clothing shapes.

pages.title: Frisk Decorating a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Frisk places a star on a small Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, smiling beside Sans and Papyrus dolls dressed in festive outfits. A Santa hat with holly, a striped sweater, and beads on the tree define the scene. The dolls sit among a Santa hat, round ornaments, and scattered decorations on the tabletop.

pages.title: Girl in a Santa Hat and Plaid Scarf Coloring Page
pages.description: A girl wears a Santa hat and thick plaid scarf in this printable coloring page, standing beside a decorated tree under hanging stars and round ornaments. Her long hair curls over a buttoned coat, while garlands cross the brick wall behind her. A small wrapped gift hangs from a bow beside the portrait.

pages.title: Ladybug and Cat Noir Holding Christmas Gifts Coloring Page
pages.description: Ladybug and Cat Noir pose together with Christmas gifts in this printable coloring page, wearing fluffy Santa hats beneath a Happy Miraculous Holidays greeting. A decorated tree rises behind their masks and festive outfits. Wrapped boxes, a large striped bow, and a curled heart shape frame the pair, with Cat Noir's bell and Ladybug's spots visible.

pages.title: Fluffy Cat Tangled in Christmas Garland Coloring Page
pages.description: A fluffy cat sits tangled in a beaded garland in this printable coloring page, with a large Christmas tree, hanging ornaments, and a star behind it. Loops of beads drape across its chest, tail, and the floor. Wood wall panels and a framed cat portrait complete the room around the cat's long whiskers and tufted ears.

pages.title: Rabbits Sitting Around a Fire by a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Three rabbits sit around a fire in this printable coloring page, wearing patterned sweaters and scarves beside a Christmas tree, wrapped gifts, and a snowy window. The central rabbit holds a large wrapped candy, while the others sit with their paws near their chests. Hanging ornaments, roof beams, and curved curtains frame the crowded holiday room.

pages.title: Girl with a Snowman and Winter Animals Coloring Page
pages.description: A girl spreads her arms beside a snowman in this printable coloring page, wearing a fluffy Santa hat and coat among squirrels, birds, and a reindeer. Snow dots and large star shapes fill the sky above the snowy ground. The snowman's carrot nose, round buttons, and hat add smaller shapes beside the girl's long curls and fur-trimmed sleeves.

pages.title: Charlie Morningstar Wearing Reindeer Antlers Coloring Page
pages.description: Charlie Morningstar raises one hand in this printable coloring page, wearing reindeer antlers and a fur-trimmed holiday outfit beside a pile of wrapped gifts. Holly decorates her headband, while a large bow, round ornaments, and two bells fill the foreground. Her long hair curves behind her beneath a handwritten Happy Holidays greeting.

pages.title: Homer Simpson Eating a Cookie as Santa Coloring Page
pages.description: Homer Simpson holds a bitten cookie in this printable coloring page, wearing a Santa hat, belted coat, gloves, and boots with folded cuffs. Crumbs fall between the cookie and his open mouth, while his large mustache and wide eyes stand out against the plain background.

pages.title: Fox in a Santa Hat Walking Through Snow Coloring Page
pages.description: A fox lifts one front paw in this printable coloring page, wearing a Santa hat and a bell collar on a snowy woodland path. Its large fluffy tail rises behind it, with pointed ears and a thick ruff framing its smiling face. Bare tree trunks, snow-covered branches, and small plants fill the background.

pages.title: Dog in a Santa Suit Holding a Doughnut Coloring Page
pages.description: A small dog holds a sprinkle-covered doughnut in this printable coloring page, dressed in a Santa hat and a belted suit with fluffy trim. A bow decorates the doughnut, and a heart appears in a small speech bubble beside its face. Outlined circles scatter around the round-bodied dog and its tiny feet.

pages.title: Santa Waving with a Sack over His Shoulder Coloring Page
pages.description: Santa waves with one gloved hand in this printable coloring page, carrying a large sack over his shoulder and smiling beneath his curled mustache. His fluffy beard spreads across a belted coat, with matching trim around the cuffs and trouser legs. A floppy pom-pom hat and rounded boots complete the figure.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man Holding Six and Seven Coloring Page
pages.description: A gingerbread man holds a striped six and seven in this printable coloring page, wearing sunglasses and a Santa hat amid stars and candy canes. Three round buttons run down his body, and wavy icing borders his wrists and ankles. Small circles and sparkles fill the spaces around the smiling figure.

pages.title: Dalmatian in Christmas Tree Glasses Coloring Page
pages.description: A Dalmatian wears Christmas tree glasses in this printable coloring page, paired with a floppy Santa hat, a collar, and a large ribbon bow. Oval spots cover its face, long neck, and chest beneath the novelty frames. Small stars and round decorations top the glasses, while a pom-pom hangs beside one ear.

pages.title: Stitch Above Merry Christmas Lettering Coloring Page
pages.description: Stitch rests his paws above Merry Christmas lettering in this printable coloring page, wearing a Santa hat and smiling with his large ears spread wide. Snowflakes of several sizes surround his head and the two rows of outlined letters. His rounded nose, small claws, and fluffy hat trim add finer details to the design.

pages.title: Tom and Jerry with Christmas Ornaments Coloring Page
pages.description: Tom holds round Christmas ornaments in this printable coloring page, looking up at Jerry, who jumps above his hat with raised fists and a flowing scarf. A small decorated tree stands beside Tom, while wrapped presents stack on the other side. Jerry's pom-pom hat floats overhead, and Tom rests one finger against his cheek.

pages.title: Grogu Wrapped in Christmas String Lights Coloring Page
pages.description: Grogu holds out both hands in this printable coloring page, wearing a Santa hat and a thick scarf with string lights wrapped around his robe. Large pointed ears stretch to either side of his smiling face. The looping cords cross his sleeves and body, with individual bulbs hanging between the folds of the robe.

pages.title: Buzz Lightyear and Aliens Decorating a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Buzz Lightyear lifts a three-eyed alien holding a bauble in this printable coloring page, while two more aliens stand beneath a decorated Christmas tree. Striped and wavy ornaments hang among the branches. Buzz's space suit panels, the aliens' planet emblems, and the large evergreen sections create a mix of small details and broad spaces.

pages.title: Minecraft Santa Running with a Gift Sack Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Santa runs with a sack of wrapped presents in this printable coloring page, wearing a floppy hat, a belted coat, and square boots. Snowflakes, a candy cane, and floating gifts surround his blocky pose. Merry Pixelmas and Blocky Holidays lettering frames the design above and below.

pages.title: Gargamel and Azrael in Santa Hats with a Smurf Coloring Page
pages.description: Gargamel holds a gift with a smiling Smurf perched on top in this printable coloring page, while Azrael sits beside a decorated Christmas tree. All three wear Santa hats, and Azrael also has a scarf. The present's large bow, round baubles, star tree topper, and Gargamel's buckled coat add distinct shapes throughout the scene.

pages.title: Mouse in a New Year Stocking with a Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: A mouse peeks from a New Year stocking in this printable coloring page, beside a striped candy cane, a wrapped gift, and holly leaves. Snowflakes, dotted bands, and diamond shapes decorate the stocking, while a round Happy 2027 tag hangs from the cuff. Small stars and snowflakes surround the coloring sheet's main design.

pages.title: Cat in a Snowflake Stocking with a Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: A cat peeks out of a stocking in this printable coloring page, with a small Santa hat, striped candy cane, and large snowflake decorations. The wide cuff and broad stocking shape leave open areas around the snowflakes and scattered crosses. Rounded cheeks and simple facial lines complete the cat at the top.

pages.title: Kitten Curled Inside a New Year Ornament Coloring Page
pages.description: A fluffy kitten curls inside a round New Year ornament in this printable coloring page, with its bushy tail sweeping up beside its face. Two raised hind paws reveal outlined pads beneath the folded front paws. A hanging loop, scalloped cap, and small sparkles complete the coloring sheet around the kitten.

pages.title: Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde in Santa Hats Coloring Page
pages.description: Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde wear Santa hats in this printable coloring page, standing beside a decorated tree while Judy holds a wrapped gift. A striped tie, fur-trimmed coat, and rows of lights on the buildings give the coloring sheet a mix of broad clothing panels and smaller festive details.

pages.title: Deku and Bakugo Wearing Reindeer Antlers Coloring Page
pages.description: Deku and Bakugo wear reindeer antlers in this printable coloring page, with thick scarves, patterned holiday sweaters, and holly decorations between the two characters. Deku folds his arms while Bakugo raises both fists beneath a Santa hat. Snowflakes, zigzags, and small stars add finer sections to the clothing and background of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Grinch Making a Finger Heart in a Santa Suit Coloring Page
pages.description: The Grinch makes a finger heart in this printable coloring page, wearing a Santa hat and fur-trimmed coat among outlined snowflakes, stars, and hearts. A heart-shaped ornament hangs beside his sleeve, while his other hand rests across the front of the coat. Large buttons and open clothing panels balance the smaller background details.

pages.title: Grinch in a Santa Hat with Crossed Arms Coloring Page
pages.description: The Grinch crosses his arms in this printable coloring page, wearing a long Santa hat with a round pom-pom and a thick, fluffy collar. His raised eyebrows and wide smile fill most of the portrait. Small hearts, dots, and four-pointed sparkles surround the character, leaving larger open areas in the hat and clothing.

pages.title: Venti in a Santa Hat Holding a Christmas Gift Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, Venti holds a Christmas present beside a decorated tree, wearing mittens and a Santa hat with holly leaves. Braids frame his face above a gift decorated with small frog faces and a large ribbon bow. Bead garlands and Merry Christmas lettering add details around the tree.

pages.title: Chibi Spider-Man in a Santa Hat with a Gift Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Spider-Man wears a Santa hat in this printable coloring page, holding a large wrapped present while extending his other hand in a web-shooting pose. Small ornaments hang from his wrist beside the suit's web lines and chest emblem. The oversized mask, ribbon bow, and broad hat sections give the coloring sheet several larger enclosed spaces.

pages.title: Lisa Simpson in a Santa Coat and Boots Coloring Page
pages.description: Lisa Simpson wears a Santa coat and boots in this printable coloring page, with a wide belt, round earring, and festive garland across her hair. A bow and round baubles decorate the garland, while fluffy trim follows the coat front, cuffs, and boot tops. The plain background keeps attention on Lisa's complete standing figure.

pages.title: Happy New Year Coloring Page
pages.description: Rounded Happy New Year lettering fills this printable coloring page in three rows between a ribbon and scattered stars. The wide letters and open ribbon loops provide large areas to color.

pages.title: New Year 2027 Coloring Page
pages.description: Two children peek over the outlined digits 2027 in this printable coloring page, with one waving and the other raising a fist. A cone hat, a large hair bow, and curling streamers frame the numbers.

pages.title: New Year Countdown Clock Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling countdown clock raises its gloved fists in this printable coloring page, with both hands pointing up at midnight. Twin bells and rounded shoes give the clock a character shape between curling streamers.

pages.title: New Year Ball Drop Coloring Page
pages.description: A faceted New Year ball sits on a tall tower in this printable coloring page, above a stepped skyline and beneath drifting confetti. Diagonal struts echo the triangular panels across the ball.

pages.title: New Year Fireworks Coloring Page
pages.description: Two children in scarves watch fireworks in this printable coloring page, raising their hands below three large bursts and a row of city buildings. The curved firework trails spread across the upper half of the scene.

pages.title: New Year Firework Rocket Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling firework rocket rises diagonally in this printable coloring page, with a pointed cap, striped body, and a trail above a cloud. Smaller bursts and diamond-shaped sparks surround the rocket.

pages.title: New Year Sparklers Coloring Page
pages.description: Two crossed sparklers fill this printable coloring page, with rounded handles below jagged bursts and small stars around the tips. Long shafts lead the eye from the bottom corners toward the sparks.

pages.title: New Year Party Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: A cone-shaped New Year party hat fills this printable coloring page, with a scalloped pom-pom, curved bands, and three outlined stars. A short ribbon curls below the wide brim.

pages.title: New Year Party Horn Coloring Page
pages.description: A curled New Year party horn stretches diagonally across this printable coloring page, with a short mouthpiece, broad stripes, and floating confetti. The spiral end shows how the paper rolls back on itself.

pages.title: New Year Party Popper Coloring Page
pages.description: A New Year party popper sends streamers flying in this printable coloring page, with a tilted tube decorated with stars and diagonal bands. Circles and diamonds fill the spaces between the curling ribbons.

pages.title: New Year Balloons Coloring Page
pages.description: Three round balloons and two star balloons rise from a bow in this printable coloring page, with small shine marks inside their outlines. The strings gather at the bottom beneath the wide balloon shapes.

pages.title: New Year Balloon Drop Coloring Page
pages.description: Balloons tumble from an overhead net in this printable coloring page, with curved motion marks and streamers beside the falling shapes. A roped railing and floorboards define the party space below.

pages.title: New Year Disco Ball Coloring Page
pages.description: A hanging disco ball takes up most of this printable coloring page, with curved grid lines separating mirror panels and four diamond-shaped sparkles around it. The panels narrow toward the edges of the sphere.

pages.title: New Year Champagne Glasses Coloring Page
pages.description: Two champagne glasses touch at their rims in this printable coloring page, with round bubbles rising above the stems and curled ribbons nearby. The matching glass shapes balance the composition on either side.

pages.title: New Year Masquerade Mask Coloring Page
pages.description: A feathered masquerade mask spans this printable coloring page, with pointed eye openings, a central star, and a slender handle on one side. Curved bands and sweeping feather edges divide the mask into separate sections.

pages.title: New Year Cupcake Coloring Page
pages.description: A sparkler tops the swirl of frosting in this printable coloring page, above a cupcake decorated with stars and round sprinkles. Vertical wrapper folds contrast with the curved layers of icing.

pages.title: New Year Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: A two-tier New Year cake fills this printable coloring page, with a clock topper, star decorations, and scalloped frosting on both tiers. A pedestal stand supports the cake beneath a row of rounded icing beads.

pages.title: New Year Cookies Coloring Page
pages.description: A clock, a party hat, and a star appear as decorated cookies in this printable coloring page, arranged on a round plate. Double icing outlines separate the designs from their baked edges.

pages.title: January 1 Calendar Coloring Page
pages.description: A January 1 calendar fills this printable coloring page, with a large outlined numeral beneath the month and two rings at the top. Stars and short accent marks decorate the date panel.

pages.title: New Year Resolutions Coloring Page
pages.description: A child writes New Year resolutions in this printable coloring page, with an open notebook, a pencil, and an alarm clock on the desk. Fireworks appear through the window behind the seated figure.

pages.title: Baby New Year Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby New Year sits with open hands in this printable coloring page, wearing a striped party hat, a diagonal sash, and a diaper. Both feet face forward beneath the curved edges of the sash.

pages.title: Father Time Coloring Page
pages.description: Father Time holds an hourglass in this printable coloring page, with long hair, a flowing beard, and wide robe sleeves framing his hands. The folds of the robe extend down toward two visible shoes.

pages.title: New Year Hourglass Coloring Page
pages.description: An upright hourglass fills this printable coloring page, with rounded pillars, outlined sand grains, and stars around its wooden-style frame. The narrow center separates the two chambers and the falling grains.

pages.title: New Year Family Celebration Coloring Page
pages.description: A family raises glasses around a New Year table in this printable coloring page, with party hats, a small cake, and fireworks through the window. A plate of fruit sits beside the cake.

pages.title: New Year Kids Party Coloring Page
pages.description: Two children celebrate in this printable coloring page, with one blowing a curled party horn and the other holding a balloon by its string. Their patterned hats stand out beneath the loose streamers.

pages.title: New Year Dance Party Coloring Page
pages.description: Two dancers raise their hands beneath a disco ball in this printable coloring page, with bent knees, festive hats, and streamers overhead. The dress folds and the bow tie add details to their silhouettes.

pages.title: New Year Bells Coloring Page
pages.description: Two New Year bells hang beneath a ribbon bow in this printable coloring page, with round clappers and stars around the flared rims. A curled streamer falls between the bells near the bottom.

pages.title: New Year Snow Globe Coloring Page
pages.description: A midnight clock sits inside a New Year snow globe in this printable coloring page, with fireworks, round flecks, and snowbanks around its base. The broad stand gives the globe two open bands to color.

pages.title: New Year Mandala Coloring Page
pages.description: A midnight clock centers this printable coloring page, surrounded by rings of bells, balloons, stars, and ribbons in a circular mandala. The repeating motifs fit inside a complete outer border.

pages.title: New Year Greeting Card Coloring Page
pages.description: A folded New Year greeting card stands upright in this printable coloring page, with a midnight clock, three firework bursts, and ribbons on its cover. The back panel peeks above the front edge.

pages.title: New Year Dinosaur Coloring Page
pages.description: A dinosaur blows a party horn in this printable coloring page, wearing a spotted cone hat above its rounded snout and short forearms. A curved tail and large clawed feet complete the standing figure.

pages.title: New Year Big Ben Coloring Page
pages.description: Big Ben rises between two firework bursts in this printable coloring page, with pointed windows, visible clock faces, and a tall spire. Lower rooflines and shrubs sit beneath the tower.

pages.title: New Year Eiffel Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: Fireworks flank the Eiffel Tower in this printable coloring page, showing its tapering frame, cross-braced levels, and wide arch at the base. Small diamond-shaped sparks sit between the larger bursts.

pages.title: New Year Sydney Fireworks Coloring Page
pages.description: Fireworks burst above the Sydney Opera House in this printable coloring page, with the Harbour Bridge behind the sail-shaped roofs and ripples below. The broad roof panels contrast with the bridge's smaller braces.

pages.title: New Year Snowman Coloring Page
pages.description: A snowman blows a party horn in this printable coloring page, wearing a striped hat and scarf beside falling confetti and curling ribbons. One twig arm supports the horn while the other reaches outward.

pages.title: New Year Penguin Coloring Page
pages.description: A penguin spreads its flippers in this printable coloring page, with a striped party hat, a bow tie, and stars around its rounded body. The belly and wide feet form separate areas to color.

pages.title: New Year Polar Bear Coloring Page
pages.description: A seated polar bear holds a sparkler in this printable coloring page, with a cone hat, bow tie, and outlined pads on its hind paws. Small stars surround the bear's raised forepaw.

pages.title: New Year Teddy Bear Coloring Page
pages.description: A teddy bear holds a star-shaped balloon in this printable coloring page, with stitched seams on its belly and paws beneath a party hat. The balloon string curves past its raised paw.

pages.title: New Year Bunny Coloring Page
pages.description: A bunny blows a curled party horn in this printable coloring page, standing on wide hind paws with long ears and a striped hat. A small tail peeks out beside its body.

pages.title: New Year Cat Coloring Page
pages.description: A cat sits in a star-patterned party hat in this printable coloring page, with a broad bow, four visible paws, and a curling tail. Streamers and confetti leave open space around the cat.

pages.title: New Year Dog Coloring Page
pages.description: A dog sits beneath a pointed party hat in this printable coloring page, with floppy ears, a wagging tail, and a wide streamer across its chest. The ribbon trails along the floor beside its paws.

pages.title: New Year Unicorn Coloring Page
pages.description: A unicorn stands beside a midnight clock in this printable coloring page, with a striped horn, flowing mane, and spotted party hat. Small fireworks sit above the head and the four hooves are visible below.

pages.title: Hello Kitty New Year Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty holds a star balloon in this printable coloring page, wearing a striped party hat, her familiar ear bow, and a scalloped dress. A waist bow and streamers fill smaller areas around the figure.

pages.title: Snoopy New Year Coloring Page
pages.description: Snoopy lifts one foot as he blows a party horn in this printable coloring page, wearing a striped hat beneath two firework bursts. His raised paws meet near the front of his chest.

pages.title: Minecraft New Year Coloring Page
pages.description: A blocky Minecraft character raises a firework rocket in this printable coloring page, with squared shoes, stepped scenery, and three bursts overhead. Straight edges separate the arms, legs, and shirt into open shapes.

pages.title: SpongeBob New Year Coloring Page
pages.description: SpongeBob waves while holding a party horn in this printable coloring page, with a striped hat, square trousers, and loose confetti around him. The curled horn extends past his cheek above his bent arm.
